OUTLINE [outline-side-scroll-platformer] tier=root score=0.041
For a side-scrolling platformer: state.platforms[] with {x, y, w, h} entries; state.player = {x, y, vx, vy, w, h, onGround}. Gravity each frame: player.vy += GRAVITY (e.g., 0.5); player.y += player.vy. Collision AFTER movement: iterate platforms; if player overlaps a platform AND was moving down (vy > 0), snap player.y = platform.y - player.h; player.vy = 0; player.onGround = true. Jump on Space: IF player.onGround THEN player.vy = -JUMP_POWER (e.g., -10). Camera-follow: subtract (player.x - canvas.width/2) from every draw x. Probes: gravity works (vy > 0 after a frame in air), can jump (player.y decreases after Space), can land (onGround flips false→true). Draw each entity via drawimage(sprite(key)) when generated art exists; fillrect/arc only as a labeled missing fallback while decoding or when no png was generated.
state: player{x,y,vx,vy,w,h,onGround}; platforms[]{x,y,w,h}; camera.x; enemies[]; goal
order: input -> vy += GRAVITY*dt -> integrate x,y -> platform collision (land only if vy>0) -> set onGround -> enemies + camera follow -> draw everything offset by -camera.x
traps:
- jump allowed mid-air: require onGround, set it false immediately on jump
- landing without zeroing vy: snap y = platform.y - player.h AND vy = 0 or it jitters
- camera offset applied to some draws only: subtract camera.x in every world-space draw
- collision checked before movement: integrate first, then resolve, or you tunnel
- onGround stays true after walking off a ledge: clear each frame, set only on landing
- code-drawn shapes layered over loaded sprites: pick ONE representation per entity
tuning: gravity 1200-2000 px/s^2; jump -500..-700 px/s; walk 200-300 px/s
probes: vy>0 after one airborne frame; Space sets vy<0 or onGround flips within ~300ms — not y!==y0 after landing; onGround flips false->true on landing
